title: Who Aggregates Information? Screening, Rent, and the Coexistence of CLOB and AMM Prediction Markets
abstract: arXiv:2609.20017v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prediction-market shares differ from traditional financial products in that, with no information or outside utility, classical delta-neutral Central Limit Order Book~(CLOB) market making cannot be financed by payoff-uninformative noise flow. Transaction-level evidence from a major prediction-market CLOB platform shows makers profiting not from spread but from carrying an under-priced side to settlement --- the empirical signature of behavioral tail demand rather than classical, randomized noise. We build this tail demand directly into the model and study an LMSR and a CLOB on the same event. A pre-shock CLOB quote inside the common-signal band is picked off; competitive quotes therefore screen informed traders out of the book. CLOB makers earn screening rent by carrying the under-priced side to resolution, while informed flow routes to the LMSR. The venues coexist: the CLOB supplies the tail-demand rent margin that lets the LMSR recover

translated_title: 谁在聚合信息？筛选、租金与CLOB与AMM预测市场的共存
translated_abstract: 预测市场股票与传统金融产品的不同之处在于：在缺乏信息或外部效用的情况下，经典的delta中性中央限价订单簿（CLOB）做市无法依靠不包含收益信息的噪声流获得资金支持。来自某大型预测市场CLOB平台的交易层面证据显示，做市商并非从价差中获利，而是通过持有定价偏低的一方直至结算获利——这正是行为性尾部需求（而非经典随机噪声）的经验特征。我们直接将这种尾部需求构建到模型中，并研究在同一事件上运行的LMSR与CLOB。处于共同信号区间内的冲击前CLOB报价会被抢先交易；因此竞争性报价将知情交易者从订单簿中筛选出去。CLOB做市商通过持有定价偏低的一方直至事件结算而获得筛选租金，而知情交易流则流向LMSR。两种交易机制因此得以共存：CLOB提供了尾部需求租金边际，使LMSR能够实现（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究揭示了预测市场中CLOB做市商依靠行为性尾部需求，通过持有定价偏低一方至结算赚取“筛选租金”并将知情交易者挤出订单簿，而知情交易流流向LMSR，从而解释了CLOB与AMM两类预测市场机制共存的经济根源。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that CLOB market makers in prediction markets earn "screening rent" by carrying the under-priced side to settlement due to behavioral tail demand, screening informed traders out of the book while informed flow routes to the LMSR, thereby explaining the economic basis for the coexistence of CLOB and AMM prediction market venues.
